name: cloudsearch
description: Amazon CloudSearch Configuration Service You use the Amazon CloudSearch configuration service to create, configure, and manage search domains.

subcommands.name: build-suggesters
subcommands.description: Indexes the search suggestions.

subcommands.name: create-domain
subcommands.description: Creates a new search domain.

subcommands.name: define-analysis-scheme
subcommands.description: Configures an analysis scheme that can be applied to a text or text-array field to define language-specific text processing options.

subcommands.name: define-expression
subcommands.description: Configures an Expression for the search domain.

subcommands.name: define-index-field
subcommands.description: Configures an IndexField for the search domain.

subcommands.name: define-suggester
subcommands.description: Configures a suggester for a domain.

subcommands.name: delete-analysis-scheme
subcommands.description: Deletes an analysis scheme.

subcommands.name: delete-domain
subcommands.description: Permanently deletes a search domain and all of its data.

subcommands.name: delete-expression
subcommands.description: Removes an Expression from the search domain.

subcommands.name: delete-index-field
subcommands.description: Removes an IndexField from the search domain.

subcommands.name: delete-suggester
subcommands.description: Deletes a suggester.

subcommands.name: describe-analysis-schemes
subcommands.description: Gets the analysis schemes configured for a domain.

subcommands.name: describe-availability-options
subcommands.description: Gets the availability options configured for a domain.

subcommands.name: describe-domain-endpoint-options
subcommands.description: Returns the domain's endpoint options, specifically whether all requests to the domain must arrive over HTTPS.

subcommands.name: describe-domains
subcommands.description: Gets information about the search domains owned by this account.

subcommands.name: describe-expressions
subcommands.description: Gets the expressions configured for the search domain.

subcommands.name: describe-index-fields
subcommands.description: Gets information about the index fields configured for the search domain.

subcommands.name: describe-scaling-parameters
subcommands.description: Gets the scaling parameters configured for a domain.

subcommands.name: describe-service-access-policies
subcommands.description: Gets information about the access policies that control access to the domain's document and search endpoints.

subcommands.name: describe-suggesters
subcommands.description: Gets the suggesters configured for a domain.

subcommands.name: index-documents
subcommands.description: Tells the search domain to start indexing its documents using the latest indexing options.

subcommands.name: list-domain-names
subcommands.description: Lists all search domains owned by an account.

subcommands.name: update-availability-options
subcommands.description: Configures the availability options for a domain.

subcommands.name: update-domain-endpoint-options
subcommands.description: Updates the domain's endpoint options, specifically whether all requests to the domain must arrive over HTTPS.

subcommands.name: update-scaling-parameters
subcommands.description: Configures scaling parameters for a domain.

subcommands.name: update-service-access-policies
subcommands.description: Configures the access rules that control access to the domain's document and search endpoints.
